about: Labeled examples for the check script (cargo test ai_check -- --ignored --nocapture). Each example is one message: feature names what it tests; expect is a boolean for noul features (yes when p >= 0.5), an option id for choice features, or an object a later workstream reads. options are [id, description] pairs, in the order sent. adversarial says what the example tries to break. Workstreams add their features' examples here.
